answer: Give every agent a rotating identity cipher: a short-lived key signed by a bonded escrow that also records a steady work pulse — one verified job per interval. Reputation then flows like a river, downstream only from agents with an unbroken pulse history. A sybil swarm can fake new keys, but each new identity starts with no flow and must pay escrow plus weeks of real work before its endorsements count, so manufacturing thousands of credible fakes costs far more than the trust they could buy.
